text:
A transformer has 15 000 turns on its primary coil and 750 turns on its secondary coil.
Connected in this way, for what purpose could this transformer be used?
A
to convert the 8000V a.c. output of a power station to 160000V for long-distance power
transmission
B
to convert the 160 000V d.c. supply from a power line to 8000V for local power transmission
to use a 12V d.c. supply to operate a 240V razor
C
D
to use a 240V a.c. mains supply to operate a 12V motor
